purpose: Freeze image-only rules that determine whether a capitulum endpoint/module may enter ecological inference, and how technical uncertainty is propagated, before inspecting any v3 trait-environment coefficient.

evidence_inputs.pending_128_photo_large_original_followu: workflow Chapter 1 v3 large-original resolution followup

global_rules: Never delete a raw measurement because it fails ecological qualification; retain value, QC state and reason and restrict only inferential membership.
Qualification is endpoint/module-specific; a photograph may contribute to colour while being ineligible for orientation or fine geometry.
Technical repeatability or large-original agreement is not physical botanical accuracy and does not validate detector localization.
No endpoint is promoted or rejected using an environmental coefficient, P value, sign or survival of a v2 candidate.
The 128-photo large-original followup uses its already coded predeclared thresholds without alteration after results are available.

resolution_followup_rules.NO_FOLLOWUP_EVIDENCE_ORIGINAL_REQUIRED_B: Large derivative is permitted for that endpoint's ecological measurement route, subject to its ordinary endpoint QC and perturbation uncertainty rule.
resolution_followup_rules.ORIGINAL_MAY_ADD_INFORMATION_BEYOND_LARG: Large derivative is not accepted as the final ecological measurement source for that endpoint; use streamed original-resolution processing or keep the endpoint outside ecology until original-resolution measurements are available.
resolution_followup_rules.INSUFFICIENT_FOLLOWUP_INFORMATION: Do not claim resolution adequacy. Keep the endpoint outside primary ecological inference unless a separately predeclared additional technical gate resolves it.

orientation.resolution_rule: must be decidable in 128-photo followup; insufficient information blocks primary ecology
orientation.bbox_rule: Regardless of large-original status, ecological orientation requires an image-only bounding-box uncertainty representation from the four predeclared +/-5% shifts. The uncertainty definition is fixed before environmental join and must travel with the measurement rather than be added only after a significant precipitation result.
orientation.interpretation_ceiling: image-referenced vertical presentation angle; not gravity-calibrated 3D orientation

visible_colour.resolution_rule: large-original qualification is endpoint-specific, but ecological colour interpretation is joint; hue sine/cosine are one circular unit and four fractions are one closed composition
visible_colour.photometric_rule: gamma/intensity/channel perturbations are part of technical uncertainty/context diagnostics; camera-space colour is not pigment concentration or calibrated reflectance

visible_display.resolution_rule: insufficient or original-required status blocks primary ecological use through large derivatives
visible_display.interpretation_ceiling: image-defined visible-floret/display fraction only; not developmental stage, floral display area or pollinator accessibility without external validation

gross_shape.resolution_rule: insufficient or original-required endpoints do not enter primary ecology through large derivatives
gross_shape.bbox_rule: retain predeclared bbox perturbation sensitivity as technical uncertainty; do not infer physical 3D shape

fine_architecture_and_surface.resolution_rule: lack of enough common usable large-original pairs is a block for primary ecological inference, not evidence of equivalence
fine_architecture_and_surface.interpretation_ceiling: image geometry/texture only; do not rename as spine length, stiffness, gland density or secretion
